 Xiaomi teases dual-screen flagship
 DT · 18 November 2026 · 3:52 AM PHT · 1 MIN READ 
 WHY flip when the back has a screen?
 PHOTOGRAPH COURTESY OF Xiaomi
 Text size A− Reset A+ Save Xiaomi is preparing to launch its 18 Pro series in the Philippines on 26 November 2026, introducing a secondary rear display designed for photography, notifications and everyday smartphone functions.
 The flagship lineup features a screen beside the main camera system, allowing users to frame selfies and group photos using the phone’s rear cameras instead of its front-facing camera.
 Beyond photography, the rear display supports quick access to notifications, music controls and other information without requiring users to turn the device around.

 DT · 18 hours ago 
 Xiaomi is also introducing customization options, including wallpapers and AI-generated app cards that can display reminders, timers and other personalized tools.
 The feature is intended to provide users with additional ways to interact with their phones while reducing the need to access the main display for simple tasks.
 The series is expected to include the Xiaomi 18 Pro and 18 Pro Max, with both models featuring the secondary screen.
 Xiaomi is scheduled to unveil the international versions in Paris on 17 November, followed by the Philippine launch on 26 November.
